target.basis: Target of the historical Cuttlefish boot (docs/upstream/VALIDATION.md, 2026-10-24, framework 84183aff); that boot is not evidence for any current candidate. device/google/cuttlefish is pinned in os/pinned-manifest.xml (283645aa, android-17.0.0_r1). The emulator reference scripts' sdk_phone64 target, roots and in-place product edits are not used

build.basis: Own OUT_DIR beside the Pixel outDir, under the shared builder lock; nothing is cleaned. droid builds the guest images into PRODUCT_OUT and hosttar the launcher host package into HOST_OUT; preflight checks that the retained tree's device/google/cuttlefish defines both. requiredImages is a minimum, not the full launcher input list, which is unverified for this tree. minFreeGiB is a policy margin, not a measured output size

sourceBinding.basis: The alpha builds the retained tree exactly as the last Pixel integration reconciled it: it never reconciles, adopts, signs apps or edits the tree. Bind it only from the builder's latest host-reconcile receipt (file name and sha256), the candidate SHA and dispatched apps of the run that wrote it; the build refuses any other candidate and any drift from that receipt's entries

hostEvidence.basis: Values from an emulator-alpha.py probe run on the builder under the lock: TARGET_PRODUCT, TARGET_RELEASE, TARGET_BUILD_VARIANT, PRODUCT_DEVICE, PRODUCT_OUT and HOST_OUT from lunch in the retained tree with the alpha OUT_DIR. Until recorded, guard and builder fail closed

artifact.name: emulator-alpha-receipt-{run_id}
artifact.basis: Only the nonsecret build receipt and SHA256SUMS; the images stay in the alpha OUT_DIR, hashed in the receipt for the separate guest operation
